mcat_image_suggestions.prompt_for_generation: A modular aluminium-and-glass office cabin installed inside a commercial office interior. The cabin has a dark anodised or powder-coated black aluminium frame with clear glass upper panels and beige or off-white opaque lower panels, a glass-panelled door with chrome handle, and a desk with a chair visible through the glass. Clean white suspended ceiling with recessed lighting above. Neutral grey carpet floor. Shot from a slight 3/4 angle to show both the front face and one side wall of the cabin. Bright, professional studio-quality lighting. Pure white or very light grey background outside the cabin. Square 1:1 composition, product centred, no people, no text overlays, photorealistic.
